# Chained ECDLP Transfers: live research queue

Updated 2026-11-17 after the first successful frozen inverse15 unit. Continue the project from crypto#3877 without repeating completed units. The open lane is [crypto#4544](https://github.com/isogeny-labs/crypto/pull/4544), ready with normal MERGE auto-merge requested; last observed head `da590ab79c5d46248644c734bac15f264d750e71` has failed gates, so no green or manual-merge claim. New result checkpoint: [inverse15 full source/text/proof/report/custody records](https://github.com/isogeny-labs/crypto/tree/checkpoints/chained-cubic-inverse15-result-20261117/research/chained_cubic_inverse_20261117). All producer claims are unsigned. [pcc:unverified]

The complete immediately preceding issue body is preserved as the exact JSON string in this result's `QUEUE_BEFORE_NEXT_UPDATE_EXACT.json`; serialization does not add a newline to the body. The older full56,981-character history remains byte-for-byte at [c331 source12 QUEUE.md](https://github.com/isogeny-labs/crypto/blob/c331063303f6275938d0c715101fa4f6e1e7a632/research/chained_richelot_balanced_chart_20261117/QUEUE.md). These snapshots preserve all prior tasks and negative evidence; this body advances their operational status. [pcc:unverified]

1. **Publish completed inverse15 through the open lane, with exact CI and artifact requirements.** Protocol `8dfcbd23ec70b3aa8baa497fe35dd3dfa1e57e74`, sourceA `14e707ea89a6f2b50f1331db50faff899255e678`, successful sourceB `fe5d0da839e0f9496f7b0326feebbedb9b80cc64`. Native6befb0:64 cubic/8 general inverse pairs,2 zero/8 sign/3 constructor controls and17 forward+17 dual comparisons pass. All classes/routes agree; forward9 LowerDegree/8 Quadratic includes both declared closed orbits. All1054 map inverse calls take the cubic shortcut,0 general; each paired interval satisfies the exact5/2 multiplication-wrapper count identities and equal inner-inverse counts. All30 phase expectations match, one new test passes and14 inherited tests are compiled/filtered. Full26,368B stdout SHA `394c8e2ad568fd6919650a46c59b324aeeda7bc005d49add2ff10592db3add32`; whole73-member1,755,772B archive SHA `6521ebf1791a4d4c7dfefcd5433b27c39878a8730c3598780f4c6627d23ed709`, every full byte/mode compared. Source A's Lean root-path rejection and65-member1,737,984B packet4c36de55 remain intact; B changes only lock selection and explicit Lean --root, with no mathematical source, population, sign, criterion or limit change. The inspected one-page result PDF is37,118B SHA `c6e2a66ca4016968e0713db78880bd25e0fc0e8c5b98845f5c55b4e6ac95fb0f`; the first-negative report is separately inspected. Whole new raw archives remain privately retained while S3 migration is unresolved; do not inline/split/rename data to evade policy.
2. **Advance complete prime-field cost accounting, then admitted native benchmarking.** Wrapper-call elimination is established at the declared boundary; it is not full Fp cost or runtime evidence because the inner Euclidean inverse receives a instead of a². Track the next bounded task first in ACTIVE and the open lane, review the exact field/poly implementation and existing cost rules, freeze its complete metric/population/controls before calls, and preserve losses as well as gains. Timing or end-to-end comparisons wait for their unchanged admission/access/budget conditions.
3. **Continue nontrivial DLP-preserving chained Jacobian maps and prime-field descent.** Preserve actual map14 and its subgroup recovery obligations while seeking a new geometric transfer rather than a coordinate-only edge. Review prior nondual, six-cycle, forced-return and field-of-definition results before choosing the next chain; an extension-field hop needs a genuine descent/composition proof and measured cost. No new untested chain or cross-prime map is claimed by inverse15.
4. **Maintain PR4544 CI custody and repair failures attributable to the lane.** Claim281b09 preserves all-event/check APIs for tracking6f18 workflows/28 checks, result2160 ready-event duplication34 workflows/56 checks, and currentDA19 workflows/30 checks with13 success/7 failure/10 skipped. Historical56-check budget excess is retained. Full35-member158,856B nine-log packet SHA `a6f318b12984358e3ada06471960aa561daa0e31f3c8eb3d5ae8c2a6cba52ea7` includes every failed-job log plus learning/size successes. The new-file artifact policy check passed; the artifact job later reports35 existing workflows with store-pull wiring gaps. Other failures are validation86tests/1 committed-tree failure, invalid AWS security token, unavailable Git-history store objects for corpus/curve names, stale currency data and shared-tool lock mismatch. Entire `.github`, `.artifacts`, tools, scripts, shared-code lock, curve/IC/corpus input subtrees match basec5 exactly. These are source/input comparisons, not a baseline CI rerun. No gate is waived. First CI read was after50min; next unchanged-head read no earlier14:40:07Z, or50min after a new substantive push. Keep one PR per lane, no tags, current head≤30 checks, normal auto-merge and all required gates.
5. **Resume original full workloads only when conditions change.** FullLP60/240/62+360/witness/7controls/feedback/post and the original12,317-class population remain EKS-only. No smaller local correctness unit substitutes for them. Keep signed independent replay, generic Rust Field/Picard formalization and complete solver/cost comparisons open. Each prints only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The theorem is conditional on standard Lean.Grind.Field; there is no new instance for the Rust cubic field and no full Picard formalization. Original and candidate share field/group arithmetic, so this is same-engine finite validation, not independent arithmetic replay. [pcc:unverified]
